pkgmetadata.longdescription: The Qt installer wizard, the privileged installer daemon (gentoo-installerd) and the repair tool for Gentoo systems that no longer boot. The daemon runs as root, formats the disk the user selected and installs a stage3 into it; the wizard talks to the daemon over a Unix socket that only root and the gentoo-installer group can open.

use.flag: Install the Btrfs tools, so the installer and the repair tool can create and check Btrfs file systems
Install efibootmgr, so the installer and the repair tool can create and repair UEFI boot entries

Install the AI rescue stick: the approver service and its init script, the kernel configuration fragment that gives the live kernel Yama, and the files of the gentoo_rescue_ai package (instructions and settings of the AI agents); only for the live disc

Install the kernel configuration fragment that gives the live kernel a generic framebuffer DRM driver (simpledrm), so that the live disc's "Safe graphics" boot entry works; only for the live disc's own kernel build
Install sbsigntools and mokutil, needed for installations that sign their boot files for Secure Boot and for the repair tool's Secure Boot checks
Install the XFS tools, so the installer and the repair tool can create and repair XFS file systems
